instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, find an application form on a government website and save the PDF as government_application_form.pdf on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for a government application form.
Locate an application form available as a PDF.
Open or download the PDF form.
Save the PDF as government_application_form.pdf on the Desktop.
Leave the PDF file on the Desktop.
